# arin_irr_route_metadata (Resource)

Manage description, user remarks and route-set membership on an existing IRR route. Does not create or delete the route. Removing this resource releases metadata ownership and leaves the remote object intact. For linked routes, reference the owning ROA or bundle handle in expected_roa_handle to establish ordering. Do not also manage these fields with arin_irr_route or arin_irr_rpsl. Import by CIDR,AS<number>.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Replace the example prefix and ASN with resources owned by your organization.
resource "arin_roa" "announcements" {
  org_handle           = "EXAMPLE-1"
  name                 = "Customer announcements"
  asn                  = 19814
  prefixes             = { "192.0.2.0/24" = 24 }
  auto_link            = true
  delete_linked_routes = true
}

resource "arin_irr_route_set" "customer" {
  name           = "RS-CUSTOMER"
  org_handle     = "EXAMPLE-1"
  description    = ["Customer route membership"]
  members_by_ref = ["MNT-EXAMPLE-1"]
}

resource "arin_irr_route_metadata" "example" {
  prefix              = "192.0.2.0/24"
  origin_as           = "AS${arin_roa.announcements.asn}"
  org_handle          = arin_roa.announcements.org_handle
  expected_roa_handle = arin_roa.announcements.handle
  description         = ["Customer IPv4 route"]
  remarks             = ["Routing contact: noc@example.net"]
  member_of           = [arin_irr_route_set.customer.name]
}

# Removing only the metadata resource leaves the route and ROA intact.
# For an existing unlinked route, omit expected_roa_handle or set it to "".
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (List of String) Ordered description lines, at least one. Each entry is one nonempty line without surrounding whitespace.
- `org_handle` (String) Uppercase maintaining organization handle. Changing it replaces the object.
- `origin_as` (String) Canonical origin ASN, such as AS64496. Changes require replacement.
- `prefix` (String) Canonical IPv4 or IPv6 network CIDR. Host bits must be zero. Changes require replacement.

### Optional

- `expected_roa_handle` (String) Expected ROA link immediately before a write. Empty (default) requires an unlinked route. Reference the owning ROA or bundle handle for linked routes. Import initializes this to the observed link.
- `member_of` (Set of String) Route sets containing this route. Defaults to empty; omission clears membership. For membership by reference, the route set must authorize this route's maintainer in members_by_ref.
- `remarks` (List of String) Ordered remarks lines. Defaults to empty; omission clears existing remarks on apply.

### Read-Only

- `auto_linked_roa_handle` (String) Currently observed ROA link, or empty for an unlinked route.
- `creation_date` (String) Creation timestamp reported by ARIN, or null when absent.
- `id` (String) Canonical prefix and origin ASN separated by a comma, for example 192.0.2.0/24,AS64496. Also used as the import ID.
- `last_modified_date` (String) Last modification timestamp reported by ARIN, or null when absent.
- `net_handle` (String) Network registration handle assigned by ARIN.
- `poc_links` (Attributes Set) POC links generated by ARIN from the maintaining organization. These cannot be configured or changed on the IRR route. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--poc_links))
- `server_remarks` (List of String) ARIN-generated link annotation, excluded from writable remarks.
- `source` (String) IRR source returned by ARIN.

<a id="nestedatt--poc_links"></a>
### Nested Schema for `poc_links`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) POC role description returned by ARIN.
- `function` (String) POC role returned by ARIN.
- `handle` (String) POC handle returned by ARIN.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import arin_irr_route_metadata.example 192.0.2.0/24,AS19814
```
